# entrepot_routing_rule (Resource)

A routing rule limits which requests a proxy repository forwards upstream (set it with `proxy.routing_rule` on an `entrepot_repository`). Use it to stop internal package names from ever being fetched from a public registry (dependency confusion), or to allow only an approved set.

A rule cannot be deleted while proxy repositories use it; when repositories reference the rule resource, Terraform updates them first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Never fetch internal package names from the public registry
# (dependency-confusion protection).
resource "entrepot_routing_rule" "no_internal_upstream" {
  name        = "no-internal-upstream"
  description = "Internal scopes are only served from hosted repositories"
  mode        = "block"
  matchers    = ["^@acme/", "^acme-"]
}

resource "entrepot_repository" "npmjs" {
  name       = "npmjs"
  format     = "npm"
  kind       = "proxy"
  blob_store = "default"
  proxy = {
    remote_url   = "https://registry.npmjs.org"
    routing_rule = entrepot_routing_rule.no_internal_upstream.name
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `matchers` (List of String) Go regular expressions over the package / image name or request path, e.g. `^@acme/` or `^acme-`. The first matching expression decides.
- `mode` (String) `allow`: only requests matching a matcher go upstream; `block`: matching requests never go upstream.
- `name` (String) Rule name. Changing it forces a new rule.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `repositories` (List of String) Proxy repositories that currently use the rule (informational). It changes when repositories are configured and is refreshed on every read; it never causes a diff.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Routing rules are imported by name.
terraform import entrepot_routing_rule.no_internal_upstream no-internal-upstream
```
